# T04 — Flow insight export references
Research: TinyFish search then fetch, 2026-11-01.

- PyVista 0.49.2 compute_derivative: https://docs.pyvista.org/api/core/_autosummary/pyvista.DataSetFilters.compute_derivative.html. Point-vector Q criterion; use the accurate derivative path, not the faster approximation.
- OpenFOAM wallShearStress: https://doc.openfoam.com/2312/tools/post-processing/function-objects/field/wallShearStress/. Output has kinematic units m²/s² and uses the patch normal into the domain. Fluid traction is the opposite sign; multiply by density for Pa. Solver post-processing can recover the field without running iterations.
- M4 Engineering Q-criterion: https://www.m4-engineering.com/whats-new/q-criterion-for-vortex-visualization. Positive Q indicates rotation dominance; thresholds are problem dependent and mesh resolution limits what can be inferred.
- Formula 1 flow-vis: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/testing-explained-rob-smedley-on-flow-vis.7nU2VePGlVrhIGa8wgCoLE. Surface traces expose flow structures; a CFD wall-shear trace is an analogue, not measured paint evidence.

## Visual references
- https://www.m4-engineering.com/static/images/blog/q-criterion-for-vortex-visualization/vortex-visualization-q-criterion.gif: coherent translucent vortex tubes, scalar colouring and clean silhouette; exported geometry only in this task.
- https://media.formula1.com/image/upload/c_lfill,w_3392/q_auto/v1740000001/content/dam/fom-website/sutton/2019/Testing/BarcelonaTestOne/DayTwo/1017346209-SUT-20190219-DSC_0760-16x9.webp: thin surface-following streaks, not free-space streamlines.

## Scientific interpretation
Ux/U∞ = 0.5 is a velocity-deficit isosurface, not an iso-surface of total-pressure loss. Export it under the requested wake_shell key with its honest definition, coloured by Cp0. Cp0 itself is total-pressure coefficient relative to the outlet static-pressure reference; upstream Cp0 is approximately one, not zero. No physical validation or mesh acceptance is implied by any diagnostic.
- PyVista surface integration API: https://docs.pyvista.org/api/core/_autosummary/pyvista.DataSetFilters.streamlines_from_source.html. `integrator_type=2` selects RK2; `surface_streamlines=True` constrains integration to the triangle surface. Reuse VTK's cell-crossing integrator rather than write a second mesh walker. Verified the installed signature before implementation.
